editorial: Cambodia is one of the easier places in Southeast Asia to enjoy without watching every dollar. Comfortable stays, tuk-tuks and casual meals are generally affordable, while spending a little more can buy a noticeable upgrade.

The main splurge is Angkor: temple passes, a good guide and an early-morning tuk-tuk can add up quickly. US dollars are widely accepted, but keep some small-denomination Cambodian riel handy for markets, snacks and short rides.
